Method of Attack: Data scraping of publicly available social media posts, forum posts, blogs, and news comments to collect information
Impacted Systems: Amazon S3 servers belonging to US Department of Defense (DOD) Central Command (CENTCOM) and Pacific Command (PACOM)
Attack Vector: Misconfigured Amazon S3 buckets accessible with a free Amazon AWS account
Indicators of Compromise: Three misconfigured Amazon S3 buckets named 'centcom-backup', 'centcom-archive', and 'pacom-archive' containing 1.8 billion scraped social media and forum posts
